name: PixelXpert
description: Android Xposed+Magisk module for Google Pixel stock firmware. Documentation and machine-readable repo metadata for agent harnesses.

gradleModules.:app: Android application module containing all product code
gradleModules.:modPackProcessor: KSP symbol processor emitting the mod pack registry
gradleModules.:buildSrc: Gradle build logic: version providers, version bump task

keyPackages.sh.siava.pixelxpert.xposed: Hooking runtime and mod pack base classes
keyPackages.sh.siava.pixelxpert.ui: Compose UI and the declarative preference model
keyPackages.sh.siava.pixelxpert.data: Preference storage and the remote provider
keyPackages.sh.siava.pixelxpert.service: Root binder and Quick Settings tiles

targetProcesses.com.android.systemui: Status bar, Quick Settings, keyguard, notifications

tree.architecture: How the system works, subsystem by subsystem

invariants: A mod pack's target process is determined by its annotation, not its directory.
Preference keys are a string contract shared between the app process and hooked processes.
The mod pack registry is generated by KSP; it must never be hand-written.
All hooking goes through XposedRuntime, the single libxposed bridge.
Hot reload state may contain framework objects only, never module objects.
Packs must release threads, sockets and receivers in onUnloaded().

knownGaps.toolchain: This checkout has no JDK, Android SDK or Gradle cache; local builds are impossible until installed.
knownGaps.tests: No test or androidTest source sets exist. There are no automated tests.
knownGaps.signing: Release signing silently falls back to the debug key when ReleaseKey.properties is absent.
knownGaps.verification: Changes cannot be compiled or executed locally; verification is by inspection only.
